data.description: List of Agent Statistics records retrieved according to query parameters.

totalAssignedTasks.description: Number of tasks assigned within the channel during the agent session.

totalOfferedTasks.description: Number of offered tasks within this channel during the agent's session.

totalAcceptedTasks.description: Number of assigned tasks that were accepted by the agent.

totalRejectedTasks.description: Number of assigned tasks that were rejected by the agent.

totalTransferredTasks.description: Number of tasks that the agent transferred to another agent.

totalEngagedDuration.description:
The amount of time the agent was engaged with a customer (in milliseconds).
Note :-
- Does not include wrap-up time and consult duration
- Includes conferencing duration since the customer is involved

totalHoldDuration.description: The amount of time for which the customer(s) was put on hold (in milliseconds).

totalWrapUpDuration.description:
The amount of time spent by the agent wrapping up customer interactions (in milliseconds).
i.e Sum of all wrap-up time metric for a given agent

totalAvailableTime.description: Duration of time(in milliseconds) outside of the idle time when an agent was available and handling contacts after logging in.

totalUnAvailableTime.description: Amount of time the agent was unavailable (in milliseconds).

averageHandledTime.description:
This is the average of the total handle time by an agent (in milliseconds)
i.e avg(engagedDuration(connected state) + hold-duration  + wrap-up time)

orgId.description: Organization ID to which resources belong.

teamName.description: Name of the team to which agent belongs.

OutAgentStatistics.description: List of Agent Statistics records retrieved according to query parameters.
